column4: CUDA context + PTX JIT then idle: no kernels, no copies

pinned H2D/D2H at link saturation: PCIe + copy engines, SM idle
CUDA kernel hammering GDDR5 (>>L2 footprint), no PCIe
CUDA VRAM allocate + first-touch + free churn: page tables
same churn through the OpenCL ICD (user-mode runtime axis)
same ALU work through the OpenCL ICD (user-mode runtime axis)
CPU arithmetic threads alone (heater load, GPU idle)
CUDA compute kernel + concurrent pinned DMA, CPU idle
composite: CUDA compute + PCIe DMA + full CPU load at once
vendor OpenCL compute across every kernel, escalating power
